mode.title: Mode
mode.description: channel = every community post listed for each handle. reference = probe the surface and report what it yielded, including what it cannot give you.

channels.title: Channels
channels.description: Channel handles such as @MrBeast, or full channel URLs.

postsPerChannel.title: Posts per channel
postsPerChannel.description: Capped at 10 because that is what one posts page lists. Older posts sit behind a continuation this Actor does not follow - see the README.

concurrency.title: Concurrent requests
concurrency.description: Parallel channel fetches. One request per channel.

tlsProfile.title: Preferred TLS profile
tlsProfile.description: Optional. All four answered 200 during recon; this is a tuning knob.

proxyConfiguration.title: Proxy
proxyConfiguration.description: Optional. Useful if pages start coming back as REDUCED.
